about: BN6's own Program Advance CrosOver (349, 0x15D) formed on BN6's Custom screen as a run has it: recipe 11 of BN6's list (0x0802BA60 on), Django D, Django2 D, Django3 D picked in that order on the first Custom screen and OK; MegaMan's next chip is the Program Advance's id from the first fight frame (BN6's check 0x08029520), and he uses it at t30. BN6's Django chips (278-280) have no art of their own (cut from the US version) and no run hands them out: this proves the Program Advance itself forms and plays (its attack deletes the foe at t67 in a longer fight), for the recipe from a run's Django chips (docs/multirom/bn6-gaps.md).
